charge_port.notes: MY2027: passenger-side DC fast-charging port is NACS native, driver-side AC port stays J1772; CCS adapter included (the Turbo GT with Weissach Package is the exception; not in this list).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: native NACS DC port and Porsche is in the Tesla Supercharger programme (the MY2025 US release covers CCS cars with an adapter; the MY2027 page does not mention Superchargers).

wheels.notes: Estimated: the 2026 Taycan Turbo GT AWD page shows 21-inch; the 2027 same trim is assumed unchanged. Carried from another model year or trim, not read for this exact trim and year.
